candidates.rationale: User is frustrated; leading with acknowledgement builds trust before moving to troubleshooting.
candidates.reply:
Hi u/frustrated_frank — I'm really sorry you're experiencing this. A checkout crash is genuinely disruptive and we want to get you unblocked ASAP.

Our mobile team has been alerted. In the meantime, could you try clearing the app cache (Settings > Storage > Clear Cache) and attempt checkout again? If the crash persists, please share your app version (Settings > About) and we'll escalate this directly.

Thank you for the detailed repro steps — it helps us fix this faster for everyone.

candidates.rationale: Some users prefer a no-nonsense response with clear action items over warm language.
candidates.reply:
Thanks for the report. Checkout crash on iOS 18.4 is now tracked as P1 on our side.

Quick mitigation: try Settings > Storage > Clear Cache, then retry. If that doesn't resolve it, reply with your app version (Settings > About) so we can correlate against the build log.

We'll post an update here once the fix is deployed.

candidates.rationale: Thread also has a commenter who found a cart-size correlation — worth gathering more data points.
